recognize_zh: CD5 染色中只有散在的反應性 T 細胞呈陽性，並在血管周圍與結節之間較密集；構成結節主體的腫瘤性 B 細胞是 CD5 陰性，可藉此與 CLL 及被套細胞淋巴瘤區分。
features: Nodular lymphoid areas composed predominantly of CD5-negative cells (blue counterstain)
Scattered individual CD5-positive small T cells within nodules
Denser CD5-positive T-cell collections in perivascular/periarteriolar areas and between nodules
Linear tissue cracks are sectioning artifact
describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemical stain on spleen shows nodular lymphoid infiltrates in which the majority of cells are negative. CD5 highlights scattered reactive T cells within the nodules and denser collections of T cells in perivascular regions and between nodules. Linear cracks represent sectioning artifact. The neoplastic B cells are CD5 negative, which argues against CLL/SLL and mantle cell lymphoma and supports splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL B cells co-express CD5 (weaker than T cells), so the nodules would appear diffusely CD5 positive.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells are CD5 positive and cyclin D1 positive, unlike these CD5-negative nodules.
A minority of SMZL express CD5, which would show diffuse staining of nodular B cells and requires cyclin D1 and SOX11 to exclude mantle cell lymphoma.
